# nerd_force1 UG (Nerd-Force1) – We build and run IT infrastructure as code. Bochum, Germany

> nerd_force1 UG (haftungsbeschränkt), brand name Nerd-Force1, builds and operates IT infrastructure as code. From Kubernetes and Ceph clusters through VPN networks, identity and user management to CI/CD, automated deployments and monitoring: a sovereign platform on the customer's hardware or in an EU cloud, hardened from day one. On top of it the team develops infrastructure software, internal platforms and apps, and AI and agentic-ops tooling, and passes the knowledge on through consulting and training. No sales layer: the people who build the platform run it. Founded 2020, part of the AI-Gruppe in Bochum, more than 100 nodes and devices in operation. Not to be confused with any other "Nerd Force": this is the company at Herner Str. 299, Gebäude B29, 44809 Bochum, HRB 16979 Amtsgericht Bochum.

Site: https://nerd-force1.com (German default at /de, English at /en; same page structure, prefix the path with the locale). Legacy domain nerd-force1.de refers to the same company.

## What we do

Four layers, with security running through all of them.

1. Platform – the foundation a company runs its software on
   - Clusters for compute and storage: Kubernetes (RKE2) and Ceph
   - Networks: VPN and zero-trust mesh (NetBird), ingress and TLS (Traefik)
   - Identity and internal user management: Keycloak SSO, HashiCorp Vault for secrets
   - IT infrastructure end to end: on-prem, air-gapped or in an EU cloud (e.g. Hetzner)
2. Operations as code – how the platform is built and kept running
   - Infrastructure as Code: every server, cluster and app declared in Git, reproducible and auditable
   - CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments: GitOps with Argo CD, no hand-made changes
   - Infrastructure monitoring and alerting: kube-prometheus-stack, centralised logs, dashboards
3. Development – software on top of the platform
   - Software development for infrastructure: operators, integrations, internal tooling, APIs
   - Internal infrastructure platforms and apps: self-hosted collaboration and business tools (Nextcloud, GitLab, Paperless-ngx, Vaultwarden, Shopware shops), custom internal applications
   - AI & Agentic Ops: self-hosted LLM inference, agent-driven operations and automation, AI tooling integrated into the platform
4. Knowledge – consulting and training
   - Infrastructure audits, architecture consulting, migrations
   - Training for teams that want to run their own platform
- Security, across all layers: hardening from day one, Wazuh SIEM/XDR, OpenCTI threat intelligence, incident playbooks, managed detection and response

## Positioning

- Sovereign: the customer's data on the customer's hardware or in an EU cloud; no vendor lock-in.
- Everything as code: reproducible, auditable, no snowflake servers.
- Security-first: Vault, SSO, mesh VPN and Wazuh from day one.
- Managed: Nerd-Force1 builds and operates the platform; the customer talks directly to the engineer who builds it. There is no sales layer and no 24×7 on-call rota – if a customer needs one, Nerd-Force1 says so and points elsewhere.

## Services and guide prices

Entity IDs: https://nerd-force1.com/#service-<slug>.

- [Core Platform](https://nerd-force1.com/en/services/core-platform) (core-platform): identity, secrets and network – HashiCorp Vault (secrets, SSH CA, OIDC broker), Keycloak SSO (OIDC/SAML, realm as code), NetBird mesh VPN, Traefik with automatic Let's Encrypt TLS. Guide price from 1,500 EUR/month.
- [GitOps Kubernetes](https://nerd-force1.com/en/services/gitops-k8s) (gitops-k8s): private cloud cluster – RKE2 HA with embedded etcd and Cilium, Argo CD app-of-apps GitOps, Ceph storage (RBD and CephFS), cert-manager, Rancher, kube-prometheus-stack. Guide price from 3,500 EUR/month.
- [Security Operations](https://nerd-force1.com/en/services/security-ops) (security-ops): managed detection and response – Wazuh SIEM/XDR with host intrusion detection and compliance, OpenCTI threat intelligence, centralised log management, alerting and incident playbooks. Guide price from 2,500 EUR/month.
- [Collaboration & Apps](https://nerd-force1.com/en/services/collab-apps) (collab-apps): self-hosted team tools – Nextcloud with Keycloak SSO, Paperless-ngx, GitLab CE and Harbor, Vaultwarden, monitoring dashboards. Guide price from 900 EUR/month.
- [Custom Engineering](https://nerd-force1.com/en/services/custom) (custom): software development for infrastructure, AI and agentic-ops tooling, legacy migrations, air-gapped and on-prem deployments, bespoke integrations, audits, consulting and training. Priced per project.

All prices are guide values; the final price is an individual quote. The [configurator](https://nerd-force1.com/en/configurator) estimates a monthly price from modules, environments, user, data and node bands, SLA (standard or business) and hosting (Hetzner or on-prem). Quotes via https://nerd-force1.com/en/quote.

## Platform

[Platform](https://nerd-force1.com/en/platform): proven open-source building blocks integrated and operated following GitOps principles, grouped into identity/secrets/network, cluster and GitOps, security and observability, collaboration and apps.
